# Trew Sync

> Self-hosted vault sync with full version history, on a server you run.

Trew syncs notes and attachments through a server the user controls. The server
holds notes and their history in plaintext; there is no end-to-end encryption.
The supported client environment is macOS, Linux, and Android with local
storage; Android sync runs in the foreground. The CLI is experimental. Settings
and plugins do not sync.

For installation requests, start with the agent runbook. Follow linked references
only as needed. The URLs below point to Markdown on the main branch; use matching
release documentation and release notes when installed behavior differs.

## Install and use

- [Agent installation runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/llm.md): Set up the server, secure connection, plugin, pairing, and verification.
- [Server setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server.md): Docker, binaries, TLS, and upgrades.
- [Obsidian plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/plugin.md): Pairing, status, history, and recovery.
- [CLI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/client/README.md): Optional headless mirror and automation.
- [Security and privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/security.md): What the server reads, devices and invites, revocation, and backups.
- [Server maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server-operations.md): Backup, restore, repair, and purge.

## Reference

- [Server command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/server-reference.md): Flags, limits, and health checks.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands, flags, and outcomes.

## Optional

- [Product comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/compared.md): Which sync option fits the user's needs.
- [Developer documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waynehoover/trew/main/docs/development.md): Design, protocol, measurements, and review history.
